description_en: Query the list of Layer 4 applications for a site
description_zh: 查询站点对应的四层应用列表
name: ListTransportLayerApplications

parameters.help_en: Site ID. You can obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html API
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1-500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The query type for the host record of Layer 4 applications. The following four types are supported, and the default is exact match.

fuzzy: Fuzzy match.
exact: Exact match.
prefix: Prefix match.
suffix: Suffix match
parameters.help_zh:
针对四层应用主机记录的查询类型，支持以下4种类型，默认为精确查询。

fuzzy：模糊查询。
exact：精确查询。
prefix：前缀匹配查询。
suffix：后缀匹配查询
parameters.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The host record of the Layer 4 application
parameters.name: record_name

Cname.description_en: The CNAME domain name corresponding to the Layer 4 acceleration application. This field is non-empty only when the site is connected via the CNAME method
Cname.description_zh: 四层加速应用对应的CNAME域名。只有站点是CNAME方式接入时，该字段才不为空

CrossBorderOptimization.description_en:
Indicates whether mainland China network access optimization is enabled. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
CrossBorderOptimization.description_zh:
是否开启中国大陆网络接入优化，默认关闭。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

IpAccessRule.description_en:
The IP access rule switch. When enabled, the IP access rules in WAF take effect for the Layer 4 application.

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
IpAccessRule.description_zh:
IP访问规则开关，开启后，WAF中的 IP访问规则对四层应用生效。

on: 开启。
off：关闭

Ipv6.description_en:
The IPv6 switch. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Ipv6.description_zh:
Ipv6开关。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭

KeepAliveProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether keep-alive protection is enabled. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
KeepAliveProtection.description_zh:
是否开启连接保持防护，默认关闭。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭

RecordName.description_en: The domain name of the Layer 4 application

ClientIPPassThroughMode.description_en:
The client IP pass-through protocol. Supported values:
off: Disabled.
PPv1: PROXY Protocol v1, which supports client IP pass-through for TCP protocol.
PPv2: PROXY Protocol v2, which supports client IP pass-through for TCP and UDP protocols.
SPP: Simple Proxy Protocol, which supports client IP pass-through for UDP protocol
ClientIPPassThroughMode.description_zh:
客户端IP传递协议，支持：
off: 不传递。
PPv1: PROXY Protocol v1协议，支持TCP协议的客户端IP传递。
PPv2: PROXY Protocol v2协议，支持TCP和UDP协议的客户端IP传递。
SPP: Simple Proxy Protocol协议，支持UDP协议的客户端IP传递

EdgePort.description_en:
The edge port. Supported formats:

A single port, such as 80.
A port range, such as 81-85, which represents ports 81, 82, 83, 84, and 85.
A combination of ports and port ranges separated by commas, such as 80,81-85,90, which represents ports 80, 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, and 90
EdgePort.description_zh:
边缘端口。支持：

单个端口，例如80。
端口范围，例如 81-85，代表端口 81、82、83、84、85。
端口和端口范围组合，端口、端口范围之间用逗号分隔，例如80,81-85,90，代表端口80、81、82、83、84、85、90

Protocol.description_en:
The protocol of the forwarding rule. Valid values:

TCP: TCP protocol.
UDP: UDP protocol
Protocol.description_zh:
转发规则协议，取值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议

Source.description_en: The specific value of the origin, which must match the origin type
Source.description_zh: 源站具体的值，需要与源站类型相匹配

SourcePort.description_en:
The origin port. Supported formats:

A single port. When the origin port is a single port, any valid combination of edge ports is supported.
A port range. The origin port can be set to a port range only when the edge port is a port range, and the range size must be the same as that of the edge port. For example, if the edge port is 90-93, the origin port cannot be set to 81-85, because the origin port range size is 5 while the edge port range size is 3, which are inconsistent
SourcePort.description_zh:
源站端口。支持：

单个端口，当源站端口为单个端口时，支持任意合法的边缘端口组合。
端口范围，仅当边缘端口为端口段时，源站端口才允许设置为端口范围且范围大小需要与边缘端口一致。例如边缘端口若为90-93，则不允许将源站端口设置为81-85，因为源站端口范围为5，边缘端口范围为3，两者不一致

SourceType.description_en:
The origin type. Supported values:
ip: IP address.
domain: Domain name.
OP: Origin pool.
LB: Load balancer
SourceType.description_zh:
源站类型，支持：
ip: IP。
domain: 域名。
OP: 源地址池。
LB: 负载均衡器

RulesCount.description_en: The number of forwarding rules contained in the Layer 4 acceleration application
RulesCount.description_zh: 四层加速应用包含的转发规则数量

StaticIp.description_en:
Indicates whether static IP is enabled. Disabled by default. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
StaticIp.description_zh:
是否开启固定IP，默认关闭。取值范围：

on: 开启。
off: 关闭

StaticIpV4List.description_en: The list of static IPv4 addresses assigned to this Layer 4 application after the static IP feature is enabled
StaticIpV4List.description_zh: 开启固定IP功能后，为此四层应用分配的固定IP，IPv4的地址列表

items.description_en: A single static IPv4 address, including the IP address and its status
items.description_zh: 单个固定IPv4，包括IP地址和其状态

Status.description_en:
The status of the IP address. Valid values:

healthy: Healthy.
unhealthy: Unhealthy.
unknown: IP address is being prepared
Status.description_zh:
IP地址的状态，取值范围：

healthy：健康。
unhealthy：不健康。
unknown：IP准备中

Status.description_en:
The status of the Layer 4 application.

deploying: Deploying. Modification and deletion are not allowed in this state.
active: Active
Status.description_zh:
四层应用状态

deploying：部署中，在此状态下不允许修改和删除。
active：已生效

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of Layer 4 applications
